_doc: Critical Infrastructure registry. This table IS the razor-sharp policy (SO_CI_RAZOR_SHARP_20260620.md). RAZOR_SHARP iff probe==GREEN AND age(last_verified)<currency_window_hours AND age(last_reeval)<reeval_cadence_days. REPLACE per replacement_policy (chronic fail/latency). Owners: id=ELON(discovery), access=Dembe, gate=Sterling, keeper=Whetstone(currency+updating). Hale has standing authority to direct refresh/revision/replacement immediately (only spend reaches Commander). Zero standing workarounds: active_workaround must be logged + burned down.

replacement_policy._doc: A CI tool -> REPLACE (ELON nominates replacement, Whetstone integrates, old tool -> graveyard) when ANY trigger fires. Failure = probe/op not-ok or timed out, or an active_workaround in place.

Whetstone (A14) owns Engage (repair execution) + keeps the weapon/tool razor-sharp. Sterling (A7) gates thresholds/SLA. ELON (A12) forward-observes better sensors. accountability_doctrine: Hale owns the entire CI process — health, maintenance, improvement. Accountability is NOT delegable; only tasks are. Persona owners (ELON=ID, Dembe=ISR/killchain, Whetstone=currency/engage, Sterling=gate) execute delegated tasks; Hale retains responsibility and MUST be made aware of every engage/escalate (OpsCenter/ci_awareness.jsonl → OODA Observe + morning brief).
